From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Results: smoke + sustained runs (initial)

Attaching the raw logs (throughput_logs_20270610.tar.gz). Summary highlights below (model: redwood-alpha-13B-quant, config: per-request gen=220 tokens avg, prompt=180 tokens avg):

Smoke (single A100-80GB, no cache):
- Median TTFT: 34 ms
- p95 TTFT: 76 ms
- Tokens/sec (sample period): 9,700 tokens/sec
- Effective QPS (avg gen 220 tokens): ~44 req/sec

Sustained 24hr (2x A100 in pool, batching enabled, KV cache warmed):
- Sustained tokens/sec (steady-state): 36,400 tokens/sec
- Sustained QPS: ~83 req/sec (assuming 220 gen tokens avg)
- p50 latency (full response): 420 ms
- p95 latency (full response): 1,200 ms

Concurrency stress (ramp to 200 inflight):
- Peak sustained QPS observed: 120 req/sec with larger batch windows; tail p99 increased to ~2.9s when concurrency > 160 without extra capacity
- Recommended SLO target: keep avg concurrency <= 120 to maintain p95 < 1.5s

Notes: these runs used Redwood default batching policy (timeout 15ms, max batch size 64). We saw ~8% throughput uplift when enabling a 10ms adaptive hold for small-burst workloads.

Marissa
Perf Eng Lead — Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai

Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Unit-econ draft + suggested deployment config

Connor team — attaching the MAP workbook with cost tabs. Key unit-econ assumptions and projections (conservative):

Assumptions:
- Model: redwood-alpha-13B-quant running on A100-80GB equivalent instances
- Infra cost (GPU + cloud infra amortized): $3.50 / GPU-hour
- Ops + monitoring + storage amortized: $0.65 / GPU-hour
- Achievable sustained throughput per 2-GPU pool (typical config): 36.4k tokens/sec (from Marissa's run)

Unit economics (conservative, include 20% buffer):
- Cost per 1k generated tokens: $0.028 (includes infra, ops, and overhead)
- Cost per sustained QPS (1 req/sec with avg 220 tokens gen): $0.98 / hour (includes amortized infra share)
- Monthly projection (FinBridge target 25,000,000 tokens/month):
  - Tokens/month / 1k = 25,000 units
  - Monthly cost = 25,000 * $0.028 = $700.00 (note: this is generator tokens only; if counting prompt tokens multiply accordingly)

Deployment recommendation:
- Canary: 1x 2-GPU pool (regional) for two weeks; monitor token-level cost and p95 latency against SLO. Ramp to 3x 2-GPU pools if average concurrency exceeds 90 for > 30 minutes.
- Autoscale policy: target CPU/GPU headroom to keep effective batching windows <= 20ms; use prefix caching for repeated prompts (we saw ~15% cost reduction in replay tests).

We'll fold these numbers into the MAP workbook and flag the conservative vs optimistic columns.

Priyom
Applied ML / Performance — Redwood Inference

Leah / Connor — answers below and next steps for the MAP signoff: 

1) End-to-end token costing: the $0.028 / 1k figure in the draft was for generated tokens only. End-to-end (prompt + gen) with your distribution (avg prompt 180 + gen 220 = 400 tokens total) increases the unit cost to $0.045 / 1k tokens. We'll make that explicit in the MAP workbook.

2) Canary and rollback criteria (proposed):
- Canary window: 2 weeks, regionally scoped (US-east) at 10% traffic. Start date: 2027-07-01.
- Success criteria: p95 full-response latency < 1.5s AND token-level cost variance <= 15% vs projected.
- Rollback triggers: sustained p95 > 2.5s for 15+ minutes OR observed token cost > 30% above projection for 30+ minutes.

3) Consolidated cost projection (FinBridge targets):
- End-to-end unit cost: $0.045 / 1k tokens
- For 25M tokens/month (end-to-end) -> 25,000 * $0.045 = $1,125 / month (conservative)
- For 100M tokens/month -> 100,000 * $0.045 = $4,500 / month

4) Next steps / owners (MAP summary):
- 6/15: Final MAP workbook update (Priyom) [attached]
- 6/18: Internal Redwood QA signoff (Marissa)
- 6/22: Shared MAP + canary plan to FinBridge procurement (Rishi)
- 7/01: Canary start (mutual)
- 7/15: Production go-live target (mutual)

Attachments: finbridge_map_v1.xlsx (MAP + costs), throughput_logs_20270610.tar.gz (raw logs), eval_prompt_set.csv (sample prompts).

If these timelines look good I will post the MAP to the shared Drive and create the HubSpot milestone with deal id FB-2026-1123.
